findings.summary: The mobile navigation disclosure button does not expose whether the menu is expanded or collapsed.
findings.fix: Initialize aria-expanded="false" on the Menu button, give the controlled nav an id and connect aria-controls; update aria-expanded on every toggle in djangoproject.js.
findings.evidence: Production button is <button class="menu-button">…Menu…</button>; its click handler only toggles active classes on button and nav.

passed: aria-labelledby/describedby/controls references resolve on homepage, download, sponsor plans, badge downloads and ecosystem pages.
Search and navigation landmarks have accessible labels.
Theme and search icon glyphs are hidden from assistive technology.
notes: Click-only copy controls and conditional message-dismiss controls were shared with the keyboard specialist for deduplication.
Redundant landmark roles and region naming preferences are not treated as WCAG failures.
